conceptual_change: Shifting from price-based mean reversion to volume-normalized momentum exhaustion. Instead of relying on price deviations, this model monitors when the raw trade volume exceeds 1.5x the rolling volume_ratio, signaling an overextended move prone to immediate mean-reversion.
rationale: This candidate is a proposed executable test derived from the selected screen survivor. It does not assert efficacy, causality, market behavior, or any performance result.
